items.en_title: Novo Hamburgo (RS) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #13
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Novo Hamburgo (RS) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 0.35; proposals close Nov 25, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
